# Riccardo Masetti

Riccardo Masetti is a Cloud and DevOps engineer based in Ferrara, Emilia-Romagna, Italy.

## Professional Focus

- Cloud-native delivery
- Kubernetes platforms

- CI/CD automation
- Observability with Grafana and CloudWatch

- Data and machine learning workflows with AWS SageMaker
- AI automation with LLMs, multi-agent workflows, Google ADK, Vertex AI, Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, and n8n

## Career Summary

Riccardo started in interface and web development, grew through backend and frontend architecture roles, moved into DBOps and platform engineering, and now focuses on DevOps, cloud infrastructure, GitOps, and AI-enabled automation.

## Selected Project

Advanced Static Publisher is a WordPress plugin created by Riccardo Masetti. It turns selected WordPress content into versioned static releases and publishes them to the user's own cloud without exposing a live WordPress, PHP, or database runtime to public visitors. Version 0.9.0 supports AWS, Cloudflare, Netlify, cost estimates, release restore, site health checks, and optional MCP access for AI assistants.

- Product website: https://aspublisher.riccardomasetti.com/
- Current status: Public beta, version 0.9.0
